from griffe.docstrings.dataclasses import Docstring

# Define a raw Google-style docstring
raw_docstring = """Summary line describing the function.

Args:
    param1: Description of param1.
    param2: Description of param2.

Returns:
    Description of the return value.
"""

from griffe.docstrings.parsers import Parser
from griffe.docstrings.dataclasses import Docstring

# Define a raw Google-style docstring
raw_docstring = """Summary line describing the function.

Args:
    param1: Description of param1.
    param2: Description of param2.

Returns:
    Description of the return value.
"""

# Create a Docstring object with Google parser
docstring = Docstring(raw_docstring, lineno=1, endlineno=None, parser=Parser.google)

# Print the kind of each structured section
for section in docstring.parsed:
